scope: ordinary settings confinement and checked runtime snapshots

initialGateFailure.resolution: Restore the original absent settings source; creating a new empty JSON object is not restoration. Project refresh recovery fixtures now use the same rule.

limitations: Only local commits and a fixed local Bridge module; no push or public distribution.
Optional native/real-process skips in broad race suites are listed separately; explicit required baseline and real-process matrix have no required skips.
Windows/Linux checks are cross-compilation, not native runtime acceptance.
Snapshot checks do not provide rooted atomic permission writes, cross-process transactions, durable approval/receipts or unknown-result reconciliation.
Provider credential separation, hook execution, background IO, remote networking, full descendant supervision, scratch lifecycle, default product policy and P3-P7 remain incomplete.
The original Nexus worktree and its pending Git operation were not modified.
